tagline.en: Yellow taxis under towers of glass, and a warm pretzel.
tagline.he: מוניות צהובות מתחת למגדלי זכוכית, ובייגלה חם.

item.en: yellow taxis stopped at a crossing

success.en: You found me between the taxis!

hintText.en: Look by the yellow taxis at the crossing.
hintText.he: חפשו ליד המוניות הצהובות במעבר החצייה.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on the visible street immediately in front of the stopped yellow taxi.
placement.occlusion: None; the child is in front of the taxi and may naturally cover part of its door, panel, and lower trim.
placement.instructions: Stand facing the viewer with feet together and arms close. Use child proportions and make the child slightly shorter than nearby crossing pedestrians.

hintText.en: Look by the taxis on the right.

item.en: a street cart selling warm pretzels

success.en: The salt got on my nose.

hintText.en: Look by the pretzel cart.

placement.support: Both shoes on the paved sidewalk in front of the cart's right lower panel, between the small girl on the left and the vendor on the right.
placement.occlusion: None; the child stands in front of the cart and may cover part of its lower panel, bottles and wheel.
placement.instructions: A school-age child stands facing the pretzel cart, in the narrow gap between the small girl in the purple top on the left and the vendor in the apron on the right. Do not touch or merge with either of them; only the cart is behind the child.

hintText.en: Look by the second cart on the left.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding behind a park bench

item.en: park benches under autumn trees, with pigeons
item.he: ספסלי פארק מתחת לעצי סתיו, עם יונים

success.en: The pigeons almost gave me away!
You found me! The leaves are so orange.

hintText.en: Look behind the benches in the park.

placement.support: Hidden feet are planted on the park path behind the bench; bodyHeight is the child's implied full standing height.
placement.occlusion: The original bench backrest provides the exact cutoff across the lower shoulders; the crouched torso and legs remain behind it.
placement.instructions: Crouch behind the bench and peek above its backrest with the full face and top of the shoulders visible. Keep the lower body hidden. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look behind the bench on the right.

artNotes: a canyon of glass and brick skyscrapers going up out of frame
wooden water towers on the rooftops
black iron fire escapes zigzagging down the buildings
a dog walker holding six leads at once
steam rising from a manhole between the taxis
chess players on a stone table at the park edge

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in New York!
completeText.he: מצאתם את {name} שלוש פעמים בניו יורק!

artComposition: Keep the elevated angle over the crowd, but make the SKYLINE dominate: a canyon of very tall skyscrapers fills the whole upper half on both sides and recedes into the distance, so the city is unmistakable at a glance. Water towers on the roofs, fire escapes down the brick fronts, a steel suspension bridge far behind. The street below is a wide crossing with yellow taxis.

tagline.en: A green river, a wooden canoe and a very loud macaw.
tagline.he: נהר ירוק, קאנו מעץ ותוכי רועש מאוד.

wardrobe: a thin light-green shirt and beige shorts

targets.action: The child is sitting in the canoe, looking straight ahead along the river.
targets.expression: calm, mouth relaxed and closed, eyes on the water ahead

item.en: wooden canoes on the green river

success.en: You found me! Paddle with me?

hintText.en: Look by the canoes on the river.

placement.support: The support point is the visible waterline at the child's mid-torso; the hips, legs, and feet continue naturally underwater.
placement.occlusion: Only the lower body is naturally submerged by visible river water; the face and upper torso remain intact.
placement.instructions: Show the child swimming upright in the open water between the middle and foreground canoes, with head, shoulders, upper torso, and arms above water. Use childlike proportions and a head size similar to children in the nearer canoe.

hintText.en: Look by the second canoe.

item.en: bright macaws on a low branch

success.en: You found me! He is very loud.

hintText.en: Look by the macaws on the branch.

placement.support: The support point is the top of the thick horizontal branch under the child's hips.
placement.occlusion: None; the branch supports the child from behind and does not cut across the face or torso.
placement.instructions: Seat the child side-saddle in the gap between the yellow-green and blue macaws. Keep the face in the clear foliage gap, with knees bent and both shoes hanging just below the branch. Match the apparent scale of the nearby child beneath the branch.

hintText.en: Look at the branch on the right.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding behind the giant roots

item.en: huge tangled tree roots at the water's edge

success.en: The roots are bigger than me!
You found me! It is cool in here.

hintText.en: Look between the big roots.

placement.support: The support point marks the child's hidden feet on the root-floor ledge behind the foreground root.
placement.occlusion: The pictured diagonal root hides the lower chest, waist, legs, and feet; the head and face remain fully visible above it.
placement.instructions: Place the child upright in the dark opening among the giant roots, leaning slightly into view with head, shoulders, and one hand visible. Match the scale of the nearby children hiding in the root system. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look at the roots by the water.

artNotes: a sloth hanging upside down from a branch
pink river dolphins surfacing
giant lily pads with a frog on one
a rope bridge between two trees
children in a wooden canoe with paddles
butterflies over the water

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in The Amazon!

label.en: A frog on a lily pad

tagline.en: The tower above a great square, a carousel and warm bread.
tagline.he: המגדל מעל כיכר גדולה, קרוסלה ולחם חם.

item.en: a bakery window full of baguettes and pastries

success.en: You found me! Want a bite?

placement.support: Cobblestone pavement immediately behind the wicker basket; footX and footY are the implied hidden shoe midpoint.
placement.occlusion: The original wicker basket and projecting baguettes hide the child from about the waist downward without covering the face.
placement.instructions: Stand behind the exterior baguette basket and lean forward slightly so the head and shoulders show against the bakery window. Keep the child comparable in implied height to nearby foreground children. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look by the bakery window.
Look by the second shop.

targets.action: The child stands on the wooden carousel deck between the poles, watching the horses. Both shoes rest on TOP of the deck and the entire body rises above it. Do not put a head or torso through the deck, under a horse, or in the floor. Use an existing pole only as a narrow natural overlap, never as an excuse to erase the legs.

item.en: a carousel with painted horses

success.en: You found me! One more ride?

placement.support: Wooden carousel deck; the projected shoe midpoint is hidden just behind the outer fascia.
placement.occlusion: The original red-and-gold carousel fascia hides the shoes and lower shins; it stays well below the face.
placement.instructions: Stand upright on the carousel deck behind its front rim, facing outward. Keep the face fully above the rim and use the same small perspective scale as the nearby carousel riders.

hintText.en: Look at the carousel.
Look at the other side of the carousel.

targets.action: The child stands on the stone paving under the striped cafe awning, peeking around the edge of the cafe doorframe. The awning is overhead, NOT a surface a child is inside. Keep the body connected from face to shoes on the paving; only an actual existing table or doorframe may cover part of it. Do not blend the legs into the pavement or another person's body.

item.en: café tables under striped awnings

success.en: A little spot in the shade!
You found me! The chairs are tiny.

placement.support: Solid cobblestone paving in front of the easel legs.
placement.occlusion: None; the child may naturally cover part of the easel and its legs behind them.
placement.instructions: Stand facing the viewer in front of the outer café easel, arms relaxed, with the whole face and both shoes visible. Match the scale of the nearby foreground children, not the adults.

hintText.en: Look beside the café tables.
Look at the café on the right.

artNotes: the Eiffel tower large and complete in the middle of the picture
a wide stone plaza in front of it, full of tiny people
a carousel with painted horses at one edge of the plaza
a bakery window full of baguettes and pastries
artists painting at easels facing the tower
flower boxes on every balcony around the square

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Paris!

reaction.en: Excuse me, that is a hat!

artComposition: The Eiffel Tower is the subject: draw it LARGE and complete, from its four feet to its tip, standing in the middle of the picture at the far side of a wide open plaza. It should be the first thing anyone sees. The plaza in front of it is full of tiny people, with the carousel, the bakery and the café tables around its edges.

tagline.en: Lanterns, carpets and a mountain of spices.

item.en: hundreds of metal lanterns hanging above a stall
item.he: מאות פנסי מתכת תלויים מעל דוכן

success.en: You found me! Look how they shine.

hintText.en: Look under the hanging lanterns.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on the narrow raised stall platform beneath the hanging lantern display.
placement.occlusion: None; the child is drawn in front of the lanterns and stored wares.
placement.instructions: Place a small child facing the viewer before the lantern wall, arms relaxed and face unobstructed. Match the short background children, clearly smaller than the nearby adults.

hintText.en: Look at the lantern stall on the right.

item.en: tall stacks of carpets in deep reds and blues

success.en: You found me! I counted twenty.

hintText.en: Look between the stacks of carpets.

placement.support: The support point is the child's seat on the flat top carpet; the shoes hang against the front of the pile.
placement.occlusion: None; the child naturally covers part of the carpet pattern behind the body.
placement.instructions: Seat the child on the top of the folded red-and-blue carpet pile, facing slightly right with hands in the lap and legs dangling toward the aisle. Use the scale of nearby foreground children.

hintText.en: Look at the carpets on the left.

item.en: tall cones of orange, red and yellow spices in open sacks
item.he: חרוטי תבלינים כתומים אדומים וצהובים בשקים פתוחים

success.en: You found me! It smells amazing.

hintText.en: Look behind the cones of spices.

placement.support: Hidden feet on the ground behind the blue-and-white patterned barrel; the child stands normally there.
placement.occlusion: The blue-and-white patterned barrel in front hides the child from the chest down; only the head and shoulders show above its rim.
placement.instructions: A child peeks out above the blue-and-white patterned barrel that stands in front of the yellow spice cone, between the vendor in the cream robe on the left and the vendor in the green robe on the right. Only the head and shoulders are visible above the barrel; keep the whole face clear and do not touch either vendor. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look at the spice sacks on the right.

artNotes: hundreds of metal lanterns hanging from a stall roof
stacked carpets in deep reds and blues
cones of coloured spices
a mint tea seller with a tall silver pot
a donkey cart loaded with baskets
striped cloth stretched overhead for shade

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Marrakech!

tagline.en: Camels, stone giants and a very old riddle.
tagline.he: גמלים, ענקי אבן וחידה עתיקה מאוד.

item.en: camels with bright woven blankets

success.en: He is taller than a bus!

hintText.en: Look by the camels.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on the visible sand; footX and footY mark their midpoint.
placement.occlusion: None; the complete crouching child remains visible in front of the sand and loose camel ropes.
placement.instructions: Crouch facing the viewer with hands on knees beside the foreground kneeling camel. Match the scale of the nearest foreground children and remain clearly smaller than the workers.

hintText.en: Look by the second camel.

item.en: a stall of coloured scarves flapping in the wind

success.en: You found me! Pick a colour.

hintText.en: Look by the scarf stall.

placement.support: footX and footY mark the seat point on the firm top of the folded textile stack; the shoes hang below it.
placement.occlusion: None; the entire seated child is in front of the scarf display.
placement.instructions: Sit upright on the front edge of the folded scarf stack, knees together and shoes dangling. Use roughly the head size of the nearby stall child and stay much smaller than the vendor.

hintText.en: Look at the stalls on the right.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding behind the great stones

item.en: enormous cut stone blocks at the foot of a pyramid

success.en: You found me! It is cool in the shade.

hintText.en: Look behind the big stone blocks.

placement.support: The hidden shoes stand on sand immediately behind the block at the given point; bodyHeight is the implied full head-to-shoe height.
placement.occlusion: The stone hides the child from the shoulders downward; the face stays wholly above its sloping top edge.
placement.instructions: Stand behind the enormous inscribed block and peek over it, showing the complete face and only a little shoulder. Use the height of the nearby foreground children, not an adult scale. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look at the stones on the left.

artNotes: three great pyramids behind the crowd
camels with bright woven blankets
the sphinx watching from one side
stalls selling scarves and little clay pots
archaeologists brushing sand off a stone
hot air shimmering over the sand

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Giza!

tagline.en: Neon at night, cherry blossom and a very busy crossing.
tagline.he: נאון בלילה, פריחת דובדבן וצומת עמוס מאוד.

item.en: a huge pedestrian crossing full of people

success.en: You found me! Which way now?

hintText.en: Look at the busy crossing.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on the dark asphalt at the near end of the pedestrian crossing.
placement.occlusion: None; the entire child remains visible in an open pavement gap.
placement.instructions: Place the child front-facing with relaxed arms and a clearly childlike build, roughly matching the nearby school-age children and distinctly shorter than adults.

hintText.en: Look at the other side of the crossing.

item.en: festival stalls with paper lanterns, masks and goldfish bowls
item.he: דוכני פסטיבל עם פנסי נייר, מסכות וקערות דגי זהב

success.en: You found me! Try the masks.

hintText.en: Look by the festival stalls.

placement.support: The implied feet stand on the stall floor behind the wooden mask display.
placement.occlusion: The dense foreground mask rack and its wooden bin hide the child from mid-torso through the feet.
placement.instructions: Show the child facing forward among the masks, with shoulders and upper torso visible and hands close to the rack edge. Use the same scale as foreground children. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look at the stalls on the left.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding under the blossom tree

item.en: cherry trees heavy with pink blossom

success.en: You found me! It rains pink here.

hintText.en: Look under the blossom tree.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on the street immediately in front of the pale car; the child may naturally cover part of its bumper and hood.
placement.occlusion: None; the car is behind the child rather than blocking them.
placement.instructions: Stand the child directly beneath the central pink canopy, facing forward with arms close to the body. Make the child about three-quarters the height of nearby adults at this depth.

hintText.en: Look at the second blossom tree.

artNotes: walls of glowing neon signs in pink, blue, green and gold
the wet street reflecting the neon in long colourful streaks
paper lanterns glowing orange over the festival stalls
cherry trees in blossom lit pink by the signs above them
a vending machine glowing on a corner
children in yukata holding goldfish bags

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Tokyo!

artComposition: NIGHT, not daylight: this one is lit by neon. Towers of glowing signs in pink, blue, green and gold cover the buildings on every side and reflect in the wet street below, and paper lanterns glow orange over the festival stalls. Keep it bright and colourful — the neon does the work the sun does elsewhere. The cherry blossom stays, lit pink by the signs above it.

tagline.en: Endless steps, a paper dragon and mist on the hills.
tagline.he: מדרגות אינסופיות, דרקון נייר וערפל על הגבעות.

wardrobe: a thin light-blue shirt and sand-coloured trousers

item.en: a long paper dragon carried by many children
item.he: דרקון נייר ארוך שילדים רבים נושאים

success.en: I was one of the legs!
You found me! He is very long.

hintText.en: Look under the paper dragon.

placement.support: footX and footY mark the child’s seat contact on the flat stone paving; bodyHeight is the implied standing height.
placement.occlusion: None. The seated child is fully foreground and may cover a small piece of scenery behind.
placement.instructions: Seat the child cross-legged on the clear paving directly below the dragon’s middle. Face forward with hands in the lap; use the same head size as nearby children. She sits on the flat stone paving of the wall's walkway, never on the hanging lantern, the pole or the dragon.

hintText.en: Look at the dragon's tail.

targets.action: The child is standing on the wall, looking up at the red lantern.
targets.expression: curious, looking up at the lantern, mouth relaxed

item.en: red lanterns strung between poles along the wall
item.he: פנסים אדומים מתוחים בין עמודים לאורך החומה

placement.support: Both shoes rest on the visible stone step; footX and footY are the midpoint between them.
placement.occlusion: None. Draw the child in front of the lantern, tassel, and pole; those objects may be partly covered behind the child.
placement.instructions: Stand the child on the broad lower stone step, in front of the low red lantern and just left of the tall pole. Match the scale of children on the nearby foreground landing.

hintText.en: Look by the red lanterns.
Look at the lanterns further along.

item.en: stone watchtowers with narrow windows
item.he: מגדלי שמירה מאבן עם חלונות צרים

success.en: I can see the whole wall!

hintText.en: Look at the steps beside the watchtower.

placement.support: Both shoes on the empty stone steps at the foot of the watchtower, in the tower's shadow.
placement.occlusion: None; the low stone parapet on the right may overlap a shoe only.
placement.instructions: A small child stands on the empty flight of stone steps beside the watchtower, below the children higher up the stairs, looking up at the tower. Use the height of the children on the stairs, not the adults. Do not touch the children on the steps above.

hintText.en: Look at the tower on the left.

artNotes: a long paper dragon carried by many children
stone steps climbing over green hills
watchtowers along the wall
red lanterns strung between poles
kite flyers on the highest tower
mist sitting in the valleys below

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in The Great Wall!
completeText.he: מצאתם את {name} שלוש פעמים בחומה הסינית!

tagline.en: A blue harbour, white sails and a surfboard or ten.
tagline.he: מפרץ כחול, מפרשים לבנים ועשרה גלשנים.

wardrobe: a plain yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, bare feet

item.en: green and yellow ferries at the water edge

success.en: You found me! Wave at the bridge.

hintText.en: Look at the water edge by the ferry.

placement.support: Feet rest on the forward deck of the central green-and-yellow ferry, behind its bow rail.
placement.occlusion: The green bow rail and side panel hide the lower legs and shoes; the face and torso remain fully visible.
placement.instructions: Stand facing forward with arms close to the body. Match the small scale of people aboard the ferry while remaining clearly child-shaped.

hintText.en: Look further along the water.

targets.action: The child is standing between the surfboards, looking at the nearest surfboard.
targets.expression: a small, easy smile, looking at the surfboard

item.en: surfboards standing upright in a row on the sand

success.en: You found me! The sand is hot.

hintText.en: Look by the surfboards.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on clear sand immediately in front of the upright surfboard row.
placement.occlusion: None; the child stands in front of the boards with the full body and face visible.
placement.instructions: Stand front-facing with relaxed arms in front of the orange surfboard. Use about the same scale as the nearby red-shirt child, slightly larger for the lower position.

hintText.en: Look at the boards on the right.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding behind the harbour rocks

item.en: big pale rocks at the edge of the harbour with rock pools
item.he: סלעים בהירים גדולים בקצה המפרץ עם שלוליות

success.en: There was a crab in there!
You found me! Look in the pool.

hintText.en: Look behind the rocks.

placement.support: The hidden feet stand on a shallow ledge behind the foreground harbour rock; the support point is concealed by the rock.
placement.occlusion: The near pale rock hides the lower torso, legs, and shoes along its visible top contour; the face remains unobstructed.
placement.instructions: Peek forward with both forearms resting on the rock top. Show the head, shoulders, and upper torso; use an implied standing height like children on adjacent foreground rocks. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look at the rocks on the right.

artNotes: the white shell roofs of the opera house
green and yellow ferries crossing the harbour
surfboards standing in a row on the sand
a big steel arch bridge
cockatoos stealing chips from a table
lifeguards on a tall wooden chair

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Sydney!

label.en: A crab in a rock pool

tagline.en: Penguins, a red hut and the whitest snow there is.
tagline.he: פינגווינים, בקתה אדומה והשלג הלבן ביותר שיש.

item.en: a long line of penguins waddling across the snow
item.he: שורה ארוכה של פינגווינים מתנדנדים על השלג

success.en: You found me! One followed me.

hintText.en: Look among the penguins.

placement.support: Both boots on the open snow just left of the penguin line, below the sledge dog.
placement.occlusion: None; the complete child is visible, standing beside the penguins without covering any of them.
placement.instructions: A child in winter clothes stands on open snow to the left of the marching penguins, facing them, at the same size as the nearby children. Do not cover any penguin or child.

hintText.en: Look at the second group of penguins.

item.en: wooden sledges loaded with boxes and rope

success.en: You found me! Push me again.

hintText.en: Look by the sledges.

placement.support: The support point is the seat on the wooden side beam; both boots descend toward the lower runner.
placement.occlusion: None; place the child in front of the cargo, allowing the body to cover only boxes, rope, and sledge boards behind it.
placement.instructions: Sit upright and sideways on the left portion of the freight sledge, knees bent toward the viewer and hands in the lap. Use the same foreground scale as the nearby seated child.

hintText.en: Look at the sledge on the right.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding behind a block of ice

item.en: big blue blocks of ice with a shining arch
item.he: גושי קרח כחולים גדולים עם קשת נוצצת

success.en: You found me! It is blue inside.

hintText.en: Look behind the ice blocks.

placement.support: The support point is hidden on the snowy shelf behind the ice buttress; the implied child stands normally there.
placement.occlusion: The visible blue ice buttress hides the child from the upper chest through the shoes; no invisible cutoff is used.
placement.instructions: Peek over the right blue ice buttress with the full hat, face, and tops of both shoulders visible; one mitten may appear beside the cheek. Scale slightly larger than the distant ridge walkers because this ledge is closer. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown. Show the head, the top of the shoulders and both hands resting on the edge of the object in front, so the child is visibly holding on to it; never a head alone.

hintText.en: Look at the ice on the left.

artNotes: a crowd of penguins waddling in a line
a bright red research hut with round windows
children pulling wooden sledges
a blue ice arch over the water
seals lying on a flat floe
a striped weather balloon being filled

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Antarctica!
